judgement.reason: The 610,000 global malaria deaths figure for 2024 is directly stated in both the WHO GHO passage and the PLOS article passage, but the quoted PLOS passage does not show that it cites WHO Malaria Report data, so that attribution part is unsupported.

units.text: WHO is identified as the data authority for the 2024 malaria estimates. Spans 16–18 of the WHO GHO portal state 'According to ... there were 282 million estimated cases ... in 2024' and attribute the mortality statistics to WHO reports, confirming the modifier 'according to WHO'.
